column1: # Recorded YAML files edited since their golden rows were recorded: path, the
# sha256 of the bytes that were reviewed (or `gone`), and the PR that edited
# it. The old backend has left the build, so these rows cannot be re-recorded.
# An edited file that still reads as recorded needs no line. A row excuses
# only the reviewed bytes: any later edit fails until it is reviewed again and
# its sha updated. A listed path whose bytes are back to the recording fails.
